cards.text: Jesus has just been baptized, and a voice from heaven said, “You are My beloved Son; in You I am well pleased.” (Luke 3:21-22) Now Jesus, full of the Holy Spirit, heads back from the Jordan, and the Spirit leads Him somewhere new.

cards.question: Full of the Holy Spirit, Jesus is led by the Spirit into the ___.

cards.text: Out there, for forty days, the devil tempts Him, and Jesus eats nothing the whole time. FORTY days, friend, and I can't make it forty minutes past the timer without sneaking a cookie off the rack.

cards.question: When the forty days of eating nothing in the wilderness are over, Jesus is hungry.

cards.text: So the devil, who's been tempting Him this whole time, steps up to a hungry Jesus with a dare.

cards.question: The devil says to Jesus, “If You are the Son of God, tell this stone to become ___.”
Hungry Jesus is staring at a stone the devil wants turned into bread. How does He answer?

answers.text: He answers with what is written
He turns the stone into bread

cards.text: Jesus answers, “It is written: ‘Man shall not live on bread alone.’” Forty days hungry and He still says no, while I once lost an argument with a single chocolate chip.
Round two. The devil leads Jesus up to a high place and shows Him all the kingdoms of the world in an instant, and then he makes an offer.

cards.question: Up on that high place, the devil offers Jesus authority over all the kingdoms of the world and all their glory.
The devil claims those kingdoms were handed over to him. What does he want from Jesus in return for all of them?
Jesus answers the devil's offer with Scripture again. Who does it say to worship and serve?

cards.text: Round three. The devil takes Jesus to Jerusalem, sets Him on the pinnacle of the temple, and dares Him: if You are the Son of God, throw Yourself down from here.

cards.question: Jesus keeps answering the devil with what is written. So this time the devil backs up his dare with ___ of his own.

cards.text: He says it's written that angels will guard Jesus carefully and lift Him up in their hands, so He won't strike His foot against a stone. Wait. WAIT. The devil is quoting Scripture now?

cards.question: Jesus answers the devil's quote with another line of Scripture. What does it say not to do?

answers.text: Put the Lord your God to the test
Climb up to the highest places
Ask the angels to rescue you

cards.text: Jesus answers, “It also says, ‘Do not put the Lord your God to the test.’” Three dares, and three answers straight from what is written.

cards.question: When the devil had finished every temptation, he left Jesus for good.

cards.text: When the devil has finished every temptation, he leaves Jesus until an opportune time. Not gone for good, friend. Just gone for now.
